    Decrypt a single block using the padding oracle attack
    
    Args:
        oracle: Function that returns True if padding is valid
        block: The block to decrypt (16 bytes)
        previous_block: The previous ciphertext block (16 bytes)
        
    Returns:

        # Modify previous block to get the right padding
